_meta.companion: data/telescopes/keck.md (same content as Markdown). Structure: sources{key: cite, file, url}; common (shared design: params, machine-readable pupil, design-only/proposed foci); keck1 and keck2 each with telescope{primary, pupil, foci[]}, params, not_found, conflicts, notes. Focus and pupil fields carry refs ('common.<param>' / 'keck1.<param>') into the sourced params.
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short verbatim quote from the saved document (rawdata/telescopes/keck/, or an earlier round's file where marked SAME FILE). derived = arithmetic done here (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). figure_readoff = a value read off a saved figure (not text-checkable; the caption quote is checked).
_meta.quote_check: 196 quotes machine-checked against the saved files' extracted text (pdftotext -layout and -raw for PDFs; tag-stripped text and raw source for HTML, decoded as UTF-8 or windows-1252): all pass.
_meta.quote_normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, multiplication sign (to x), division slash and tilde operator normalised; whitespace collapsed; a quote also passes against the text with PDF line-end hyphenation removed or closed up, or with all whitespace removed; ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces.
